kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: Amid talk of public execution, public opinion on death penalty is split
wire.summary: A majority of Americans support the death penalty for people convicted of murder, but support becomes more divided when questions vary.

wire.title: Israeli settlers beat Palestinians and a U.S. photojournalist in West Bank attacks
wire.summary: Masked Israeli settlers attacked Palestinians as they were harvesting olives in the occupied West Bank on Friday, injuring several people including a photojournalist working for The Washington Post .

wire.title: Crowds throng New Delhi and wave Indian flags amid escalating protests
wire.summary: Protests have intensified over a review of voter lists that critics say is politically motivated and threatens to disenfranchise voters. The Election Commission and Modi's administration deny these allegations.

wire.title: Sally Rooney's books will no longer be sold in U.K. after Palestinian Action support
wire.summary: The Irish author said her books can no longer be sold in the UK after she pledged the royalties to a banned pro-Palestinian group.

wire.title: Teen kills 4 at Oregon school. And, DOJ sues California over alleged noncitizens
wire.summary: A teen opened fire at an Oregon elementary school, leaving three kids and one teacher dead. And, the Justice Department is suing California over alleged noncitizen voters.

wire.title: What this bankruptcy says about AI startups
wire.summary: Character.AI collected millions of users, making it a very appealing acquisition. Google took a unique route to "acquiring" it, hiring away its founders and licensing its technology. Now Character.AI is filing for bankruptcy. Here's what to know.

wire.title: How much money has Musk given to Republican groups since July? The quiz knows
wire.summary: Plus, this week saw comings and goings at the White House, the revenge of a child (reality) star, and Elon Musk doing Elon Musk things.

wire.title: Do Americans own the president's papers? Appeals court to weigh in
wire.summary: The administration says papers created in the White House belong to Donald Trump, not to the American people. The case could ultimately end up at the conservative-leaning Supreme Court.

wire.title: Remembering Oscar-winning actor Eva Marie Saint
wire.summary: Saint, who died Oct. 6, studied at the Actors Studio and was best known for her roles in On the Waterfront and the Hitchcock film North by Northwest. Originally broadcast in 2000.

wire.title: 'Everything got worse': Gen Z express frustration, regret after Trump vote
wire.summary: A focus group of eight Gen Z Trump voters reported feeling unhappy or disappointed with the state of politics, with some going as far as to say they regret supporting him in 2024.

wire.title: Inside Ukrainian offensive pushing Russia back on front line where Starlink plays a key role
wire.summary: The BBC joins Ukraine's Operation Vivaldi as it regains crucial territory in the Donbas, but optimism has been dampened by souring relations with President Trump.

wire.title: Palestinians and US journalist injured by Israeli settlers in West Bank harvest attack
wire.summary: The BBC sees masked settlers attack Palestinians trying to harvest olives, amid a surge in similar incidents.

wire.title: Zelensky says Ukraine has right to defend itself after Trump calls latest strikes a 'disgrace'
wire.summary: EU leaders rally around Ukraine's president after new criticism from Donald Trump, who says Zelensky is "more difficult to work with than Putin".

wire.title: Pope pictured for first time since surgery and cancer diagnosis
wire.summary: The pontiff was diagnosed with lung cancer after having surgery at Rome's Gemelli Hospital on Tuesday.

wire.title: India's 'cockroach' party founder detained ahead of protest
wire.summary: The youth-led movement had called for a Delhi protest after mass detentions last week and the jailing of two leaders.

wire.title: US senators call for investigation into Ukraine's Starlink restrictions
wire.summary: Ukraine says temporary speed limits to the Starlink internet network disrupted its battlefield missions.
